findings.problem: This theorem contains a nontrivial weighted finite-sum overlap proof duplicated by the private `local_mass_sum` helper in `HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean`. Both establish the same bound: if each cell belongs to at most K selected sets, then the sum of nonnegative cell weights over those sets is at most K times the total weight.
findings.proposed_change: Move the generic overlap lemma into `HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean` as a shared, non-private theorem, replacing its `local_mass_sum` proof with a call to that lemma. In this file, retain `sum_selected_cells_le_overlap` as a thin compatibility wrapper if its public name must be preserved, with its proof delegating to the shared lemma. Under the existing hypotheses, the uses here at line 65 and in `manuscript_histogram_overlap_energy` at `HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean` line 70 can both call the shared lemma with `S J w hw _ hK`. The shared proof can retain the existing argument: rewrite the inner sums as sums over all cells using indicator functions, commute the sums, then apply the per-cell overlap bound and nonnegativity.
findings.benefit: Maintaining the indicator-sum argument in one shared proof avoids divergence between two identical generic bounds and makes both geometric-energy proofs easier to maintain, while preserving the target theorem's public interface if needed.

theorem sum_selected_cells_le_overlap {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset κ) (J : κ → Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ i, ((S.filter (fun k => i ∈ J k)).card : ℝ) ≤ K) :

private theorem local_mass_sum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset κ) (J : κ → Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ i, ((S.filter (fun k => i ∈ J k)).card : ℝ) ≤ K) :
have hsum := sum_selected_cells_le_overlap S J w hw _ hK
have hsum := local_mass_sum S J w hw _ hK
